row.evidence: Sisense documents SAML, OIDC and JWT SSO with 'SSO can create new users and modify user permissions' (JIT) plus Active Directory import, but no SCIM endpoint appears anywhere in its 585-topic documentation.
row.notes: No SCIM documented; user automation is JIT via SAML/OIDC/JWT SSO and Microsoft Active Directory import (Enterprise tier per docs). Plans page lists Self-serve (Try free) and Enterprise (Contact us) with no prices; SSO is named only on Enterprise there, while docs tag SAML as Grow and Enterprise. REST API covers users, roles and audit logs (GET /api/v2/audit, Enterprise). Deleting a user deletes their dashboards. None by absence.

plans.name: Self-serve
plans.notes: The plans page lists only Self-serve and Enterprise. The docs tag features with Launch / Grow / Enterprise tiers, which do not appear on the plans page.

limitations.text: Full REST reference is a Swagger UI (developer.sisense.com/guides/restApi/v1/) that also ships inside each Sisense server; the spec file could not be fetched, so only endpoints named in the docs are listed.

okta.notes: OIN page has only SAML checked; no SCIM or provisioning capabilities.

fallbacks.other_sync: Microsoft Active Directory import (Enterprise tier); AD group members are created on first login
fallbacks.notes: JIT via SAML 2.0, OIDC and JWT SSO (Grow and Enterprise per the docs tier tags).
